# Independent Q5_K/Q6_K graph fixtures

Generated by `experiments/vision-catalog-qualification/diagnostics/arithmetic-fixtures/pr380-k-graph-oracle.cpp` against llama.cpp commit `2cbca389f515df455412dafa07e2b1359cc72a6d` on x86_64 AVX2/FMA/F16C. Uses actual CPU graph dispatch with ordinary weight buffers: batch sizes below eight use vector dot; batches eight and above use the tiled kernel. Fixtures contain synthetic inputs only. All 60 shape/thread combinations were bit-exact against the new native API; no model qualification is implied.
